# GroupedListItem

A grouped settings-style row with optional secondary value and named Slots.

## Props

| Prop | Requirement | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | Required | string | The row label and accessible name. |
| `value` | Optional | string | Optional secondary row value. |
| `disabled` | Optional | boolean | Whether row activation is disabled. |
| `onPress` | Optional | Plugin event object or `toast` action object or `navigate` action object or `openUrl` action object or `copy` action object | The action run on activation. |

| `accessories` | `Text`, `Button`, `Stack`, `Row`, `Column`, `GroupedListItem` |

Does not accept child nodes on the wire.

## Accessibility

- **Accessible name:** The required `label` is the spoken name. The optional `value` is secondary text.
- **Keyboard:** When `onPress` is set, the row exposes link semantics and Enter activates it on web. Disabled rows cannot activate.
- **VoiceOver:** A row with `onPress` exposes link semantics. It reads the label and optional value and reports disabled state.
- **TalkBack:** A row with `onPress` exposes link semantics. It reads the label and optional value and reports disabled state.
